title: wenzelia paludosa
intro: Wenzelia paludosa, commonly known as Marsh Wenzel or Marsh Zingiber, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It has been found to have several health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of nausea and fever. The therapeutic actions of Wenzelia paludosa include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can be beneficial in treating wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
